prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1049; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not put my full name on it yet, if that's all right. I can confirm I was the passenger in the vehicle.

Q: That's fine for now. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Katy, Texas. We were heading through on a green light when a car came in from the side and hit the passenger door.

Q: Do you recall which direction the other vehicle was traveling?

A: It came from our right. I didn't see it coming, so I can't say how fast it was going.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was belted in.

Q: Did you hit your head during the impact?

A: I think I hit the window or the pillar. Right after, I was dizzy and had a bad headache. I didn't lose consciousness, but I was confused for a while.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I was taken to the emergency room that day and they diagnosed a concussion. I've been told to rest and avoid screens as much as I can.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. The headaches come and go, and I get tired faster than usual. Bright light bothers me, and I've had trouble concentrating at work.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to this statement?

A: Only that I'm still following up with my doctor, and I'll send over the records once I have them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
